answer: Retroactive Cluster Audit: after each epoch, cluster agent actions by timing and task similarity, then flag rings whose internal coordination exceeds chance. Flagged identities lose accumulated reputation and future task eligibility, so every fake identity must independently forge plausible history. An attacker pays the full compute and latency of maintaining each persona across many epochs before detection, and a single umber flag collapses the whole cluster. Auditors accept a small false-positive rate to keep the dune of genuine newcomers from shielding fakes.
